values.title: Roasted Harvest Bowl
values.text: A flexible template for a warm, colorful meal.

values.caption: Swap ingredients for what is in season and what you enjoy.

values.text:
## Ingredients

- 2 cups chopped seasonal vegetables
- 1 cup cooked grain
- 1 cup cooked beans
- Olive oil and seasoning
- A spoonful of your favorite dressing

## Method

1. Cut the vegetables into similar-sized pieces.
2. Roast until tender, checking as they cook.
3. Warm the grains and beans.
4. Arrange in a bowl and add dressing.

Adjust the quantities and seasoning to suit your table.

values.title: Make it yours
